# P22.3 — Migrate Eleutheria to build memory v2 (EL.1)

**Spec:** `~/agent-skills/.agents/design/build-memory-v2-spec.md#EL.1` (relocated 2026-09-09 from `~/MetaHarness/`) (Part 0 + Part I contracts) · **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/P22.3__build-memory-v2-migration.md`
**Base:** `devin/sig-postbuild-capstone` (PR #68, `625d802`) — the current chain tip (the round-1 capstone landed on top of P22.2/PR#67).
**Requirement ids:** BM-MIGE-01..07, BM-COMPAT-04..05; SIG-ENG-001, SIG-ENG-003, SIG-ENG-031, SIG-ENG-039.

## Summary

Migrates this repo onto **build-memory v2** (SK.1, `agent-skills` `main` `2c59325`; ADR-073): retire the
gitignored `.agents/scratch/`, commit the build's memory under `docs/build/` in the v2 layout, convert the
machine ledger to `docs/build/LEDGER.md`, complete `BUILD_INDEX.md` for the post-build chain + capstone
(rows 47–66), seed `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`, record the decision as **ADR-073**, and vendor the layout
validator into `make docs-check`. **Move/rename only — no product code changed** (one exception, below).

The round-1 capstone (PR #68) already ran, so the migrated ledger reflects **Round 1 COMPLETE incl. the
capstone**; the Round-2 tail (`P23.1…P23.7`) is instantiated as a **delta** over it (`nextTicket: P23.1`).

## Design decisions / reconciliations (vs the stale EL.1 text)

1. **Base = the capstone tip (PR #68), not P22.2/PR#67** — the capstone landed since the spec was written.
2. **Round 1 is DONE incl. the capstone**; ADR count 71 → **72** with ADR-073 (spec said 71, stale).
3. **Relocated pre-v2 `docs/build/` root files into `reports/`** — the v2 root allowlist (the merged SK.1
   validator) permits only a fixed set of root entries; the capstone/post-build tickets had deposited ~23
   report files + the functional `okc/`, `live_runs/`, `rights/` subtrees at the root. Move-only,
   byte-identical, recorded in the mapping. EL.1's deliverable text did not anticipate these (the spec
   predates them); this is the faithful way to reach "v2 layout" + "validator exit 0".
4. **One code-adjacent change (deviation from "no code change"):** two **test** files
   (`tests/connectors/test_stage0_outreach.py`, `tests/connectors/test_pathway_coverage.py`) hard-coded the
   paths of two relocated report files (`STAGE0_OUTREACH_RECORD.md`, `STAGE5_CONNECTORS.md`); their path
   **constants** were repointed to `docs/build/reports/` — a behaviour-identical moved-fixture reference
   repair (assertions unchanged; zero product-`src` references exist). Without this, "validator exit 0" and
   "make check green" could not both hold. No product code (schemas/wire-names/behaviour) changed. Runtime
   write-path defaults in product code (`connectors/runner.py` `LIVE_RUNS_DIR`, `exports` deposit-ledger CLI
   default, the acceptance harness) still target `docs/build/` root paths and were **left unchanged**.

## Part VIII — personal-data scan (RISK-P22-05)

Scanned every newly-committed file (migrated `LEDGER.md` + `runs/*` + `pr/*` + `reports/*`, DEFERRALS/ADR/
manifest/docs/register edits) before staging: **no** emails (only `@pytest` decorators in diff fixtures),
**no** SSN/phone/plate patterns, **no** home addresses, **no** private-individual PII — only **public
officials, public agencies/vendors, public source URLs, and gate ids (HG-nn)**. The validator's secret grep
(`AKIA…`/`sk-…`/`ghp_…`/PEM/`xox…`) is green; ledgers record credentials as `provided: yes/no`, never values.

No `docs/tickets/P*.md` renamed; no ADR body / register row / historical ledger rewritten; the Round-2 tail
tickets are **not run**; nothing merged/tagged/pushed to `main` (operator integrates). This PR is stacked on
`devin/sig-postbuild-capstone` (PR #68).
